This document outlines the sweet cooling water inspection which must be 
 performed every 
 1000 hours of operation

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Khalil darwish reviewed & 
 tested by eng. Sobhy Tolba Ahmed at 1 March 2009, accepted by eng. Abdel Fatah 
 Mohamed Shehata approved by eng. Goma Khater khadr: head sector of Kafr 
 Eldawar power station
The sweet cooling water technical data
Rate quantity of cooling water : 1800 m3/hr

Number of cooler :2 
 Total length of pipes :4.7m
Number of pipes in each cooler : 1610 pcs

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, shoes, ...etc.
Be sure the pipeline is drained

Inspect gasket and replace with a 
 new gasket if necessary

Clean tube cooler by source 
 pressurized water jet

Inspect tube leakage by pressurized 
 the shell and blocked any pipe leaks

Clean cooler and check the outlet 
 water temperature

Introduction
This document outlines the sweet cooling water inspection which must be 
 performed every 
 1000 hours of operation
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Khalil darwish reviewed & 
 tested by eng. Sobhy Tolba Ahmed at 1 March 2009, accepted by eng. Abdel Fatah 
 Mohamed Shehata approved by eng. Goma Khater khadr: head sector of Kafr 
 Eldawar power station
The sweet cooling water technical data
Rate quantity of cooling water : 1800 m3/hr
Number of cooler :2 
 Total length of pipes :4.7m
Number of pipes in each cooler : 1610 pcs
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, shoes, ...etc.
Equip. item | Safety steps | Position
Disconnect | Open | Closed
Manual | Inlet sweet water valve |  | x | 
Manual | Outlet sweet water valve |  | x |

Manual | Outlet river water valve |  |  | x
Manual | Drain river water valve |  | x |

Tools 
and Equipment
Rubber ball
Complete maintenance tool set.
Source pressurized water jet
Standard bolt drivers set
Work to be 
carried out
Be sure the pipeline is drained
Open cooler
Inspect gasket and replace with a 
 new gasket if necessary
Clean tube cooler by source 
 pressurized water jet
Inspect tube leakage by pressurized 
 the shell and blocked any pipe leaks
Clean cooler and check the outlet 
 water temperature
